inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Cots and mats were observed to not be labeled with the children's names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §747.4303(b))

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A hole was observed on the bottom of the wood fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: The play yards in the home were observed without sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §747.2311(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: 74 7.1327(c)(1)(A) - Documentation of Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Includes Trainer information: The primary caregiver's CPR/First Aid training has expired since 10/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: 74 7.1327(c)(1)(A) - Documentation of Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Includes Trainer information (26 TAC §74 7.1327(c)(1)(A) - Documentation of Pe)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection, two people living in the home were observed without an eligible background check in the system.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: The operation did not have activity plans available to review during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers - Orientation: The substitute's orientation training was not available to review during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers - Orientation (26 TAC §747.1303(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The liability insurance information has not been updated since 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.209(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: The primary caregiver had eleven children in her care by herself. 7 out of 11 children were below 17 months old.  It was corrected at the inspection time when the substitute caregiver arrived at the home 10 minutes after the inspection initiation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Menus: The menu for the daycare home were not available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Menus (26 TAC §747.801(4))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification: The children's products certification form was not available during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §747.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 out of 11 children did not have immunization records available at the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: 2 out of 11 children did not have the authorization for emergency medical information available during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Supervision was not maintained when the primary caregiver left seven infants by themselves in a room unsupervised.    It was corrected at the inspection time when the primary caregiver was advised to supervise children at all times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 5 out of 11 children's records did not have a statement information from a health-care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility: There was not a carbon monoxide detector in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility (26 TAC §747.5331)

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The emergency practices documentation was not available during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The parent's rights form 2987 was not available at the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year: There is no documentation to verify a lock-down drill was conducted during the year prior to inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §747.5005(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There is no documentation of a fire drill conducted during the year prior to inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: A child's immunization exemption form  lapsed beyond the two year period from notarization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering drill for Severe Weather- 4 times in a calendar year: There is no documentation of a sheltering drill during the year prior to inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering drill for Severe Weather- 4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §747.5005(2))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Two infants were observed laying on the bouncer for more than 15 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §747.2317(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Documentation for Primary Caregivers of Licensed Home - Original Transcript or Training Certificates: The original CPR/FA for the primary caregiver was not available for reviewed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation for Primary Caregivers of Licensed Home - Original Transcript or Training Certificates (26 TAC §747.1131(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: The CPR/FA for the assistant caregiver was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Several bottles for infants were observed in the kitchen counter and  not labeled with their names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §747.2319(5))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies for the licensed child care home was not available for reviewed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: The admission information for two children were not available for reviewed.   One chilld admission information was missing parent signatures.  One children admission information was missing the health statement and and immunimzation records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement: The Infant Care area was obsered, the crib placement was observed located next to each other with no space in between which can lead to an infant reach to anothe crib,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement (26 TAC §747.2303(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The infant feeding instructions for two infants were not up to date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §747.2321(b))
